messages:
Noah: Heads up 1: our billing heatmap shows a sudden per-token cost jump for tenant `beta-labs` around 06:30 UTC. Looks correlated with the quota-aware routing rollout (v2).
Asha: Do you mean higher cost per token or higher total bill?
Noah: Per-token. Their /chat route moved some traffic from model-x-small -> model-x-medium to satisfy token quota limits, but medium is producing ~15% longer outputs on average, so billed tokens up. The console shows cost_per_token = $0.0014 -> $0.0019 for that tenant.
Ravi: That's surprisingwe expected medium to be marginally cheaper amortized. Could be tokenization differences (different tokenizer configs) or a batching side-effect (longer completion because of stop-token behavior). Any example traces?
Noah: Pulled a few request samples and paste below: 
```
request_id: rq_20260323_001
model_variant: x-small -> x-medium (reroute)
prompt_tokens: 42
completion_tokens_xsmall: 120
completion_tokens_xmedium: 138
```
Asha: 15% exactly. Also saw a pattern where x-medium is including an extra trailing newline + signature in its completions. That would inflate tokens.
Ivy: The console's per-model card currently aggregates by `reported_tokens` emitted by the router, which for rerouted requests is written twice: one for the initial decision and once for the final. That can inflate billed tokens if we naively sum. We should switch to aggregating by final_decision_id.
Ravi: We emit quota_action events that include a `decision_id`, but upstream instrumentation didn't wire that through the billing pipeline. Adding that will let us de-duplicate.
Noah: For immediate mitigation can we add a tenant-level overlay that compares per-route average completion_tokens pre/post rollout and flags >10% delta? Users saw this and pinged finance.
Asha: I can add a quick spot check in the dashboard: a sparkline that shows median completion tokens for the last 24h vs previous 24h and a red flag if ratio > 1.1. Low-risk change.
Ravi: Longer term: 1) ensure billing pipeline uses final_decision_id for dedupe (me) 2) normalize tokens by tokenizer mapping across model variants during comparison (Ivy + infra) 3) update routing policy to prefer token-stable variants for quota fallbacks (product + routing) 4) add alert rule in console (Asha).
Ivy: Quick SQL I used to find dup writes: 
```
SELECT decision_id, COUNT(*) as writes FROM billing_events
WHERE tenant = 'beta-labs' AND ts > '2026-03-23'
GROUP BY decision_id
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1
```
Noah: That returned ~3k duplicate decision_ids across the 06:30-07:00 window.
Asha: I'll add the overlay and the '% delta' flag as a feature-flagged toggle so we can ship to prod fast and enable for finance-only initially.
devops-bot: Release note: dashboard/spotcheck-overlay -> canary at 2026-03-23T10:00Z, full rollout pending.
Ravi: I'll open the billing pipeline PR to use final_decision_id and add a dedupe window (30s) for safety: https://github.com/redwood-inference/billing/pull/511
Ivy: For tokenizer normalization plan: create a tiny mapping table per model family that maps token boundaries and run a nightly reconcile job to compute an adjusted completion_token estimate. I'll draft a spec.
Noah: Finance expects a write-up. Asha, can you export the dashboard sparkline and a short explanation for support?
Asha: Yep, will attach a one-pager and the dashboard link in #incidents once the overlay is live.
Noah: Ok keeping this thread to track the fixes. Reopen if the overlay shows more tenants with >10% jump.
